notes.title: December 2024
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/9760652e58f128f59776eef46c2b84e66f99236b.jpg[/img]

As the year draws to a close, here’s a quick rundown. Before you tune out, let me present the agenda—maybe one of the topics will catch your interest, and you can jump straight to it:

1. **Priest Simulator**  
2. **Mercyful Flames**  
3. **Taxi Simulator**  
4. **Your Principal**  

[h1]Priest Simulator[/h1]

Our most recognized franchise so far is keeping us busy:

The **Vampire Show** has left Early Access. However, we’ve already received feedback about some messed-up lipsync and issues with the final raid not registering correctly. We’ve fixed the first problem, and we’re working on the second. A patch is on its way.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2947900/Priest_Simulator_Her_Ghost_DLC/

We’ve released *Her Ghost*, a DLC for *Vampire Show*, offering about an hour of new gameplay. Some of you may remember that we declared the game finished months ago, but for various reasons, the launch was delayed. Sure, any game can be endlessly improved, so we added a few more cards to the Trello board. Plus, we wanted to experiment with creating DLC, so we decided to add new content roughly on the scale of *Heavy Duty*. Big thanks to everyone who purchased it.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/a600c086e2e6a9d8b55b48b80c2334850957a4b6.jpg[/img]

We also made the soundtrack available some time ago. You can listen to it on Spotify or YouTube. The music video for the standout track *Legion* is doing pretty well at festivals:

- Winner: Best Polish Animated Music Video at PL Music Video Awards 2024  
- Winner: *Black Horse of Music Videos* at Ars Independent 2024  
- Semi-finalist: Azyl Shorts 2024  

It was also officially selected for:  
Animakom Fest 2024,  
Żubroffka 2024 (Music Video category),  
Animest 2024,  
Splat!FilmFest 2024,  
Grand Video Awards 2024 (Music Video category),  
Offeliada 2024,  
Linoleum 2024.  

Watch it here:  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oMop-7BM4ds  

That’s not all the news from the *Priest* universe. We’ve been working for months on the next installment, *Wolf Moon*. It continues threads from the previous games but takes them in a very different direction. It’s a low-poly action RPG inspired by MOBAs and *Vampire Survivors*. We intended to release the Steam page this year, but it’s not yet up to our standards.

[h1]Mercyful Flames[/h1]

We’ve really gone all out on this one. Last year, we made the tough decision to rework the game completely—a decision that was challenging but ultimately necessary. The original concept of a card-based RPG might resurface in a future project, but not here. *Mercyful Flames* always had great atmosphere but struggled with the transition of our physical designs into a digital format. 

This time, we went all in, inspired by a friend’s comment: “I’d buy a *Priest* game that’s just cutscenes.” While it’s an oversimplification, it nudged us toward creating a minimalist, gameplay-light experience.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/9f43649f9c317bbbe19503dc7c6f5949339f975b.jpg[/img]

The game is going through what feels like its hundredth iteration. I admit I’ve gone a bit obsessive, tweaking every little detail. We keep adding minor dialogues or effects to enhance the illusion of a living world. The game is divided into dozens of “scenes,” and polishing one often makes others look subpar in comparison. At that point, we have to even things out, one way or another.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1066740/Mercyful_Flames_The_Witches/

As with *Vulgator*, we’ve collaborated with acclaimed Polish artists. This time, we worked with *Alembik*, a duo comprising Robert and Michał. You might know Michał from *Owls Woods Graves*, *Over the Voids*, and *Mgła* (live). They composed the soundtrack, which will also be available as a standalone album on streaming platforms.

[h1]Taxi Simulator[/h1]

Now for our biggest project. We’ve been dedicating our lives to this one and regularly post devlogs about its progress. The game has a completely different vibe from anything we’ve done before—less experimental, more craftsmanship. This time, the title isn’t some ironic twist; it’s exactly what it says.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159390/Taxi_Simulator/

**Your Principal** is temporarily on hold by mutual agreement with the publisher. We’ll return to it next year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1176330/Your_Principal/

Apart from these titles, we’re also working on a port—or rather, a remaster—of a certain hit, but we’re not revealing any details yet.

By the way, you might have read rumors that we’re quitting game development to start selling weapons. Some reliable Polish media outlets got their facts and companies mixed up. I won’t bother denying it because it works in our favor.

notes.title: Micropatch
notes.content:
[h1]Hi,[/h1]

Another cold patch flies in today, fixing small bugs. We're not getting lazy, we're fixing, we're working, so check out the list of changes below. 
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where if you load the game on the "Drive home" task, you cannot drive the Polonez away (you cannot complete the game). 
[*] The translation of cold fruit distillate in Turkish has been changed to the correct one (it was Chinese before xD).
[*] The name of alpha-amylase in the Russian language has been aligned with the UI.
[*] Fixed the closing screen in the Italian version to show the correct subtitles (previously it was the same text everywhere).
[*] The ability to bypass JP in Act 4 after the wood has been blocked. 
[*] Fixed a bug where hovering over the closed door to Quella's room would display a message that the vacuum cleaner was missing.
[/list]
That's it. It wasn't much, but we realize that these little bugs are always the most annoying. We've fixed everything we can, so feel free to fire up the game and enjoy the gameplay, or at least pretend to enjoy it. If anything, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/]Booze[/url] is now on a promo. Thanks for all the reviews and comments. Stay tuned.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/

notes.title: New year, old Booze
notes.content:
[h1]Hi,[/h1]

Damn, it's already 10 January 2024. We've just finished working on the demo [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/url][/b] and the release of the full version is behind us (we celebrated it as wildly as New Year's Eve). It's a new year, but good old Booze is still the same, so download the game and shoot the moonshine till you drop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/d693ca6b99a70f02be0aa21942e2c78cff9563e7.jpg[/img]
[h2]Update [/h2]
We are working on the next update which will be released soon. We'll be fixing some bugs in it, so if there are any problems or you've found bugs, drop us a line on [url=https://discord.gg/cn49DFdUpA]Discord[/url] and we'll try to fix them as soon as possible, or at least try not to screw them up anymore. Here's a list of what's coming in the next update.

[list]
[*] [b]Helpful markers[/b] - among other things, a pointer to the reception door.
[*] [b]Subtitles[/b] - will be more in line with the in-game dialogue. We are also filling in the gaps in some of the translations.
[*] [b]New old locations[/b] - Iice spikes will be placed all over the map, blocking the exit from the area. Moving to a new part of the map will also be impossible without unlocking the corresponding vodka.
[*] [b]Landmarks[/b] - we will be adding maps to make it easier to navigate locations, as well as a statue to act as a landmark.
[*] [b]Damned cutscenes[/b] - we're working on improving some of the cutscenes, but we're not going to give you all the details just yet.
[*] [b]New music[/b] - there will be new music in several cutscenes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/b70dbd4e369ab01c8520f23a9ebdb2bbad73f5de.jpg[/img]

That's not all we plan to add in the latest update, but there's no need to spoil everything. We'll reveal more in the next devlog, but that's it for now. Thank you for your support, feedback, and presence. May [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057600/Booze_Masters_Freezing_Moonshine/]Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine[/url][/b] bring you more absurd moments and alcoholic adventures this year. Freeze the vodka, make the moonshine, and don't forget we've got a couple of Booze bundles with other games. Check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1057600/view/3898492375377104628]the full list[/url], you might find something you like. Thanks again for your time and best wishes for the New Year. Take care.

[url=https://discord.gg/cn49DFdUpA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/a11ebc2fa7bc7962c775e3abe8eef705d2288571.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Cold Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]Hi,[/h1]

We've just taken the first hotfix out of the oven - beware, it's still hot. As we mentioned in the devlog yesterday, we have been working hard to fix some of the bugs you have been telling us about. What's more, the list of fixed bugs has grown a bit since yesterday, so be sure to grab the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/b9dc74114c62feb238b8064e6f1da49d240c6ff6.jpg[/img]
[h2]List of fixed bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b] Mushroom Quest[/b] - You will no longer need to make 3 moonshine to progress the story. You will receive one mushroom needed for the task by solving the puzzle, and the other two will be waiting in an easily accessible location.
[*] [b] The process of making moonshine[/b] - From the start, you will have 4 bottles at your disposal at the crushing stage instead of one. Do not waste them.
[*] [b]Fix the radiator [/b]- If you don't have the right recipe, the light will flicker wildly to indicate that you can't jump on it.
[*] [b]Moody snowman[/b] - The snowman, who hangs the decorations faster than he was told to, will finally start to do his job properly (forgive him, Zero-Karoten is like that).
[*] [b]Music in cutscenes[/b] - You said that in some scenes there is no music and there is no sound, so we changed the volume and it should be fine.
[*] [b]Let's Shut Jerry Up[/b] - We're adding the ability to mute Jerry at a certain point in the game because you pointed out that he's quite annoying.
[*] [b]Fast harvest[/b] - To collect items such as things to the radiator, plants from the garden, or planting plants, you do not need to click, just hold the button. Let's respect each other's fingers.
[*] [b]Collider fixes[/b].
[*] [b]Last cutscene[/b] - We've expanded it a bit to make your last moments with Booze last longer.
[*] [b]Olds saves[/b]-  Unfortunately or fortunately, saves from the demo version will not work. Relive this adventure.
[/list]
If you have any problems, please contact [url=https://discord.gg/cn49DFdUpA]Discord[/url] and we will do our best to help you. We will solve all your problems! Well, maybe not with the alcohol, but we can do it with the game. Until Wednesday there is a [b]15%[/b] discount, so you can buy the game for the weekend and have a good time with Booze over a beer, if that's not enough for you, you can check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1057600/view/3898492375377104628]devloga[/url] with bundles and buy two games instead of one. We'll keep working, stay tunned.

[url=https://discord.gg/cn49DFdUpA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/a11ebc2fa7bc7962c775e3abe8eef705d2288571.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: A hotfix is coming
notes.content:
[h1]Hi,[/h1]

The excitement hasn't died down after yesterday's launch of Booze, and we're still working on it. We have received a lot of messages from you, positive reviews, and feedback on what could be improved. There will be an update tomorrow to fix some bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094915/ff9c58bab5d5685ce56ec0b0ca974a9674b3eb76.jpg[/img]
[h2]List of bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b] Mushroom Quest[/b] - You will no longer need to make 3 moonshine to progress the story. You will receive one mushroom needed for the task by solving the puzzle, and the other two will be waiting in an easily accessible location.
[*] [b] The process of making moonshine[/b] - From the start, you will have 4 bottles at your disposal at the crushing stage instead of one. Do not waste them.
[*] [b]Fix the radiator [/b]- If you don't have the right recipe, the light will flicker wildly to indicate that you can't jump on it.
[*] [b]Moody snowman[/b] - The snowman, who hangs the decorations faster than he was told to, will finally start to do his job properly (forgive him, Zero-Karoten is like that).
[*] [b]Music in cutscenes[/b] - You said that in some scenes there is no music and there is no sound, so we changed the volume and it should be fine.
[*] [b]Let's Shut Jerry Up[/b] - We're adding the ability to mute Jerry at a certain point in the game because you pointed out that he's quite annoying.
[*] [b]Fast harvest[/b] - To collect items such as things to the radiator, plants from the garden, or planting plants, you do not need to click, just hold the button. Let's respect each other's fingers.
[*] [b]Collider fixes[/b].
[/list]
Remember, if there's a problem, you're stuck in a rock, or you don't know where to find the damn plant, we're always here to help. Be sure to follow us on our [url=https://discord.gg/cn49DFdUpA]Discord[/url] to stay in touch. Feel free to write, we don't bite - unless we get hungry. If you haven't bought Booze yet, check out the previous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1057600/view/3898492375377104628]devlog[/url] as we've made some great bundles with other games. Stay tuned for updates.

notes.content:

Hello everybody.

Especially, hello Sir Kepi. Thanks for your criticism, your commitment motivates me. I really appreciate you took so much time to make us aware of how important the devlogs are.

I promised the demo will be released soon, and our goal is to deliver it for the October festival.

Here is the list of bugs/features that need to be fixed/implemented/designed etc. Pasted directly from our Trello. They are listed in various forms, but I hope they will be clear to you as they are to the developers.

1. Fix resolution issues.
2. The cheap vodka recipe dissapears.
3. Game crashes in window mode.
4. Text placeholders in English version (visible on the screenshot).
5. No voice over during cutscenes.
6. Still some old tasks are poping up.

TBH, 19 and 20 are the biggest issues now. The rest is just a matter of ~week. When those 44 are gone, we are ready to release the demo.
